title: The best habit tracker
body: This the best habit tracker on Appstore! Believe me, I'm very picky, I downloaded like 30 different apps and some of them had not a very nice design, or TOO many features so everything looked chaotic, or you couldn't track your habits by month/year. Evoday is the best!! It has a lovely design, you can track everything by week/month/year, you can add notes! I downloaded it to develop the habits of songwriting and playing the piano and now I have a 5 week streak! And Evoday helped a lot! Thank you very much! 💖
author: marikalarionova
